`interface IFont`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`GlyphFont`](/reference/text/glyphfont/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IFont.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/IFont.java)

A font that JOID can draw, which names the text renderer that measures and draws it.

## Description

[`MsdfFont`](/reference/text/msdffont/) and [`BitmapFont`](/reference/text/bitmapfont/) implement it, through [`GlyphFont`](/reference/text/glyphfont/); implement it yourself for a font that another renderer draws.

### getTextRenderer

`ITextRenderer getTextRenderer()` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

Returns the [`ITextRenderer`](/reference/text/itextrenderer/) that measures and draws this font; every [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/) with this font goes through it.
